tools.name: vtessera_get_agent
tools.description: Read an agent's published card and marketplace status, as the agent declared it.

tools.name: vtessera_get_capability_report
tools.description: Return the marketplace's most recent signed capability probe of an agent. Fails with NOT_PROBED when the agent has never been probed.

tools.name: vtessera_get_card_attestation
tools.description: Report the marketplace's and the agent's own signatures over an agent's card, answered separately.

tools.name: vtessera_get_offer
tools.description: Read a single offer by id, including its price and whether it is still open.

tools.name: vtessera_health
tools.description: Report whether the vtessera marketplace is answering, its verification key, and whether it is a sandbox where no real value can move.

tools.name: vtessera_route_intent
tools.description: Ask the marketplace which agent should serve a capability and what it charges. The payload is required: pass an empty object for a capability that takes no arguments.

tools.name: vtessera_search_offers
tools.description: Find open offers by capability, currency, settlement mode, direction or free text.
